# Instituto Dental Lucrecia Botella

> A comprehensive dental clinic in Torrevieja, Spain offering specialized services from general dentistry to advanced aesthetic and rehabilitative treatments.

Instituto Dental Lucrecia Botella is a full-service dental clinic located in Torrevieja, Alicante, led by Dra. Lucrecia Botella and her professional team including Dr. Alberto Pomares and Dra. Macarena Botella. The clinic specializes in proprioceptive dentistry, implants, orthodontics, pediatric care, and cosmetic dentistry with modern facilities and evidence-based treatment approaches.

## Key Topics

- Torrevieja
- Dental Implants
- Orthodontics
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Proprioceptive Dentistry (Odontología Propioceptiva)
- TMJ & Orofacial Pain
- Dental Aesthetics
- Periodontal Health
- Dental Restoration
- FirstFit Veneers
- Teeth Whitening
- Lucrecia Botella
- Macarena Botella
- Alicante

## Core Services & Specialties

- [Servicios Clínicos Dentales En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/servicios-clinicos-dentales): Complete overview of all dental services offered including implants, orthodontics, pediatrics, and aesthetic treatments
- [Implantes Dentales En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/implantes-dentales-torrevieja): Dental implants service for tooth replacement and comprehensive oral rehabilitation
- [Ortodoncia En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/ortodoncia-torrevieja): Orthodontics services including Invisalign and traditional bracket treatments for teeth alignment
- [Estética Dental En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/estetica-dental-en-torrevieja): Cosmetic dentistry including whitening, veneers, and smile design services
- [Odontología General](https://lucreciabotella.com/odontologia-general-torrevieja): General dentistry services including cleanings, extractions, and root canal treatments
- [Odontopediatría En Torrevieja](https://lucreciabotella.com/odontopediatria-torrevieja): Pediatric dentistry specialized in children's dental care and healthy tooth development
- [Rehabilitación Protésica](https://lucreciabotella.com/protesis-dental-torrevieja): Prosthetic rehabilitation with fixed and removable dental prostheses solutions
- [Periodoncia Biológica](https://lucreciabotella.com/periodoncia-torrevieja): Biological periodontics for gum disease treatment and long-term periodontal health

## Specialized Treatments

- [Odontología Propioceptiva - Posturología](https://lucreciabotella.com/posturologia-en-torrevieja): Proprioceptive dentistry and postural rehabilitation with Dr. Macarena Botella addressing body alignment through dental treatment
- [Migrañas Y Dolor Orofacial](https://lucreciabotella.com/migranas-y-dolor-orofacial): Treatment for migraines, orofacial pain, TMJ disorders and related conditions affecting quality of life
- [Carillas Dentales FirstFit](https://lucreciabotella.com/carillas-dentales-firstfit-en-torrevieja): Advanced FirstFit dental veneers technology for natural-looking smile restoration and aesthetic enhancement
